metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.5 · 1990 · The Hunt for Red October
metas.description: Moscow, Washington D.C. and a CIA Analyst track a rogue Soviet Captain and his new submarine.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.9 · 1992 · Patriot Games
metas.description: When CIA analyst Jack Ryan interferes with an IRA assassination, a renegade faction targets him and his family for revenge.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.9 · 1994 · Clear and Present Danger
metas.description: CIA Analyst Jack Ryan is drawn into an illegal war fought by the US government against a Colombian drug cartel.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.5 · 2002 · The Sum of All Fears
metas.description: CIA analyst Jack Ryan must stop the plans of a Neo-Nazi faction that threatens to incite a catastrophic conflict between the United States and Russia by detonating a nuclear weapon at a football game in Baltimore, Maryland.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.2 · 2014 · Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
metas.description: Jack Ryan, as a young covert C.I.A. analyst, uncovers a Russian plot to crash the U.S. economy with a terrorist attack.
